Build Europe's semiconductor future with us! future talent.• Make recruitment better: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, solve operational challenges, and continuously improve recruitment efficiency and service quality.Your profile• A Office applications and applicant tracking systems, with an openness to learning new tools and processes.• Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken; Mandarin would be an advantage.• Confidence working in an international and culturally diverse environment, including occasional meetings across different time zones.• Willingness to travel occasionally for recruitment events and career fairs.Reasons to join ESMC• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits : We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to re

GROHE ist eine führende globale Marke für ganzheitliche Badlösungen und Küchenarmaturen und bietet dank der innovativen Wassertechnologien „Pure Freude an Wasser“. GROHEs Markenwerte Technologie, Qualität, Design und Nachhaltigkeit unterstreichen den Anspruch der Marke für den Nutzer außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen. Innovation, Design und Entwicklung sind dabei stets eng aufeinander abgestimmt und als integrierter Prozess fest am Standort Deutschland verankert. Damit tragen GROHE Produkte das Qualitätssiegel „Made in Germany“. GROHE wurde als Vorreiter seiner Branche mit dem Corporate Social Responsibility Preis der Bundesregierung ausgezeichnet sowie vom renommierten FORTUNE® Magazin in das Ranking der Top 50, die „die Welt verändern“ aufgenommen. Seit 2014 ist GROHE Teil von LIXIL – dem Pionier für richtungsweisende Wassertechnologien und Gebäudeausstattung. Please apply with your CV in English. We are looking for a highly motivated and proactive Supplier Quality Manager (Europe) (d/f/m) at our site in Hemer or Düsseldorf to establish and maintain a robust quality ecosystem across our European supplier base. This role requires a strategic mindset to drive supplier quality improvements, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance with LIXIL standards and processes. The ideal candidate will have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a passion for innovation in quality management. Key responsibilities and main challenges:·         Implement advanced supplier quality control processes to enhance supplier performance and achieve key performance indicators (KPIs).·         Develop preventive risk mitigation processes using APQP methodologies and predictive analytics.·         Support key suppliers in establishing quality firewalls through periodic training and continuous improvement initiatives.·         Assist the sourcing team in supplier selection and evaluation through audits and performance monitoring.·         Conduct supplier audits based on VDA6.1 and VDA6.3.·         Collaborate with the regional quality team on new product development quality, focusing on PPAP/ISIR verification.·         Analyze supplier quality issues and drive corrective actions using 8D, 5-Why, and APDCA methodologies.·         Continuously monitor and improve supplier quality performance.·         Validate key supplier laboratories according to specifications and standards.·         Lead competency development and internal training for the European SQM team. Your profile:·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Technology or Engineering.·         Certified VDA6.1/IATF16949 and VDA6.3 Auditor.·         Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in quality management leadership within a manufacturing environment. Experience in the electronics or automotive industry is preferred.·         Advanced knowledge and application of AIAG/VDA Core Tools (e.g., APQP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA).·         Strong problem-solving skills with expertise in methodologies such as 5W1H and 8D.·         A proactive and open-minded team player with excellent communication skills.·         Strong proficiency in English and German (written and spoken).·         Willingness to travel within Germany and across Europe (approximately 40%). Our offer:·         A dynamic and diverse role in a growing, modern, and global company.·         Flexible working hours with the option for remote work.·         Attractive compensation based on the collective agreement for the metal and electrical industry, plus additional company benefits.·         Access to a variety of employee perks, including an on-site fitness center.·         On-site cafeteria at various locations.·         If you are passionate about quality management and supplier development and want to contribute to a dynamic and innovative environment, we encourage you to apply! Interested?We look forward to receiving your application via our softgarden application portal!If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. https://grohe.softgarden.io/job/58298717?l=de (https://grohe.softgarden.io/job/58298717?l=de)Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Problemlösungsmethode 5W, Instandhaltungsmanagement, Materialwissenschaft, Messmethoden (Umgang, bestimmen etc.), Industrial Engineering, Messtechnik, Mechatronik, Projektmanagement, Mess-, Steuer-, Regeltechnik (MSR), Informationstechnik, Computertechnik, Materialphysik, Qualitätsmanagement, Werkstoffprüfung, Technische Mechanik

Typical assignments include the implementation of new electronic-invoicing mandates, other legal and regulatory requirements, and business-driven changes that affect Finance processes, integrations, data, controls and operational procedures.The role is designed for an experienced SAP Financials professional who has moved into project coordination and delivery management. accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and stakeholder alignment in a large international SAP landscape.Your responsibilitiesEnd-to-end project delivery- Own the delivery of assigned About AtariAtari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Hipster Whale, Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.About the roleMünster, Germany · Part-timeThe Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.What you’ll do- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.Requirements & Qualifications- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.Nice to have- Professional proficiency in French.- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.How you’ll workThis role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.Why join AtariThis role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.EEO StatementAtari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. Von AI bis 5G, vom autonomen Fahren bis zur Raumfahrt - nahezu jede bahnbrechende Innovation von heute hat ihren FormFactor.Job Description:Field - Service Engineer (m/f/d)who performs installations, troubleshooting and repairs at our customers' sites.In our company, your core responsibilities include:- Supporting our Wafer Probe System product in the EMEA region- Installation & commissioning of probers and accessories, including final acceptance according to test and acceptance regulations- Independent execution of preventive & corrective maintenance at the customer's site in the service area EMEA- Technical training and instruction of customers- Troubleshooting and repair of our probers both as remote / telephone support and at the customer's site- Timely processing and documentation of work orders and service calls according to FormFactor guidelines- Actively collaborate with other FormFactor departments to ensure continuous improvement of products- Regular participation in qualification measures- Adherence to all health and safety requirements both internally and during customer service callsWhat you should bring with you:- Engineer or technician in the field of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, automation technology or similar- At least 2-4 years of experience in a similar field of activity is typically required, ideally in semiconductor industry- Detail-oriented work and strong problem-solving skills- Accuracy, punctuality, good team and interpersonal skills- Good communication skills in German and English both verbally and in writing- Good knowledge of common MS Office applications- Valid driving license and willingness to travel requiredSkills:Deutsche Sprache, Elektromechanik, Englische Sprache, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Optik, Optische Messtechnik, OptoelektronikEducation & Experience:Minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; jobs.occupation: Procurement Consultant – IT Procurement (m/f/d) (Fachwirt/in - Einkauf/Bachelor Professional in Procurement)
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!How you will make an impact?As a Procurement Consultant, you will manage strategic procurement activities for IT products and services. You will advise internal stakeholders, lead competitive sourcing processes and negotiate commercially attractive and sustainable agreements.Acting as the interface between our internal teams and external suppliers, you will help translate business and technology requirements into effective sourcing strategies. You will also contribute to supplier performance, category initiatives and the continuous development of our procurement approach.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Manage procurement activities for IT products and services from initial demand through supplier selection, negotiation and contracting;- Advise and support internal stakeholders in developing the appropriate sourcing and procurement approach;- Prepare, lead and execute RFIs, RFPs and other competitive sourcing processes;- Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers, considering price, quality, risk, flexibility and long-term business value;- Analyze supplier proposals and create transparent commercial evaluations and management recommendations;- Act as a key interface between internal stakeholders, Legal, Finance, Security and external suppliers;- Support contract development and ensure that commercial requirements, responsibilities and deliverables are clearly defined;- Manage supplier relationships and contribute to structured governance, performance reviews and continuous improvement;- Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership, consolidate demand and optimise the supplier portfolio;- Contribute to category strategies, market analyses and procurement initiatives;- Support procurement-related projects and continuously improve sourcing processes, templates and ways of working;- Manage several procurement activities in parallel while ensuring quality, transparency and timely delivery.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Several years of professional experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management or a comparable commercial role;- Solid understanding of IT procurement, including software, cloud, professional services, managed services or other IT-related categories;- Experience in leading sourcing processes and commercial negotiations with national and international suppliers;- Good understanding of commercial and contractual models, such as fixed-price, time-and-materials, subscription, managed-service and outcome-based arrangements;- Ability to analyse complex offers and translate commercial information into clear recommendations;- Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different functions and seniority levels;- Confidence in challenging requirements and supplier proposals constructively;- A proactive, structured and results-oriented working style;- Ability to work independently, prioritise a varied workload and meet agreed deadlines;- Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills;- A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to the further development of the procurement organisation;- Fluent English, both written and spoken. German would be an advantage.What success looks like in this role:- Internal stakeholders receive pragmatic, reliable and commercially sound procurement advice;- Sourcing activities are executed transparently, efficiently and in line with business requirements;- Negotiations deliver measurable commercial value while maintaining sustainable supplier relationships;- Commercial, contractual and supplier risks are identified early and addressed appropriately;- Procurement is recognized as a strategic partner that enables business outcomes rather than only processing transactions.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Procurement Consultant - PRC3 (Md7).
